instruction: Please enhance the colors in my desktop photo to make them more vibrant.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. Color enhancement/vibrance adjustment in GIMP is a subjective operation similar to the original brightness task. What constitutes 'more vibrant' is subjective, and without ground truth metrics for color vibrance levels, the task cannot be objectively evaluated.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - color vibrance enhancement is inherently subjective
No objective metric exists to measure 'more vibrant' without ground truth
The infeasible() function is the appropriate evaluator for subjective visual quality tasks
Metadata provides clear explanation for why this task cannot be objectively verified
